# Scope of the Base Problem

The stack label is treated as a pound-mass value, converted with 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg, and multiplied by the assigned gravitational acceleration. The specified 205 MPa value is the tensile yield strength used for the 304 stainless-steel pin, and shear yield is estimated by the von Mises relation. The result is an average direct-shear exercise, not a complete certification of the pictured machine. Product design must also address pin bending, plate and stem bearing, tear-out, fatigue, wear, clearance and impact, stress concentrations, material condition, manufacturing details, and the actual cable-machine geometry.
